machine_extruder_start_code.default_value:
; FELIX Food Switch - Tool 0 Activation G-code - V1.00
G92 E0
G1 E{switch_extruder_retraction_amount + switch_extruder_extra_prime_amount, 0} F{switch_extruder_retraction_speed * 60, 0}
G92 E0

machine_extruder_end_code.default_value:
; FELIX Food Switch - Tool 0 Deactivation G-code - V1.00
G92 E0
G1 E-{switch_extruder_retraction_amount, 0} F{switch_extruder_retraction_speed * 60, 0}
G92 E0
